items.title: Travelodge’s New CEO Inherits Safety Reckoning, Rising Costs and Looming Debt
items.snippet: Skift Take: Travelodge has a new chief executive, 38 safety recommendations to implement, and debt to refinance. Peter Krueger starts Tuesday. Travelodge's new boss is a former investment banker, and he'll need to be. The UK budget hotel group named Peter Krueger CEO on Thursday alongside third-quarter results that showed earnings falling.

items.title: Hotel Groups Sell Brands and Loyalty, Not Rooms, Luxury Starts Selling Time, and Tokens Wait for Proven Income
items.snippet: Thursday asked what the largest hotel groups actually sell, finding brands and loyalty rather than rooms, and why luxury hospitality now sells freedom of time as much as it sells ownership.

items.title: Jet Airways staff to get Rs 480 crore gratuity, PF dues with interest: NCLAT
items.snippet: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) on Thursday ordered the Jet Airways liquidator to pay Rs 480 crore in pending gratuity and provident fund (PF) dues, along with interest, to eligible employees of the defunct airline within two weeks.

items.title: Hospitality Asset Forum 2026, relive the morning
items.snippet: The 16th edition of the Hospitality Asset Forum took place on November 23 at the InterContinental Paris Le Grand. Three financing cases put to a vote of the room, a Covivio-Generator duo opening up their contracts, Philippe Journo recounting the Sax and what followed, and a Spanish closing session where B&B Hotels announced its 1,000th hotel in Seville.

Radisson Golf View Resort Pahalgam elevated to Radisson Blu
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group has announced the elevation of Radisson Golf View Resort Pahalgam to Radisson Blu Golf View Resort Pahalgam, strengthening its presence in Jammu and Kashmir. With this transition, the property moves from the upscale to the upper-upscale segment within the Group’s portfolio.

items.title: Air India Group to streamline operations under ‘One Air India Group’ structure
items.snippet: Air India and Air India Express will come under a unified management framework called ‘One Air India Group’, aimed at reducing costs, improving operational efficiency and optimising resources across the two airlines.
